items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: We have Britt Woodman, Art Baron, Jerry Dodgion and Harry Allen... That’s when I went with the Ellington band, yes.

ctx.x: They had the whole — that was the prime: Hodges and Harry—
Harry and Paul and Jimmy Hamilton. It was amazing.
Were they on every night, from one night to the next? Can you remember that?
